component.name: AI FOUNDRY GPT-5.2 AGENT (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)
component.description:
What it does Sends a prompt to GPT-5.2, a model the platform runs for you in Azure AI Foundry, and returns the reply. There is no API key to bind: the platform holds the credentials.

How it works Write a system prompt - the standing instruction - and a user prompt - the message. Anything in ${braces} is filled in from the data arriving at the node, so the default ${prompt} sends whatever arrives in the prompt field. If the user prompt is blank, or names a field that did not arrive, the incoming data itself is sent instead. The tokens used are priced from the platform's model catalogue and recorded against the run. If the call fails, or the model answers with no text, the run fails rather than passing an empty answer on.

Configure
- Model - gpt-5.2 by default; any other managed model in the list can be chosen.
- System Prompt - the standing instruction. "You are a helpful assistant." by default.
- User Prompt - the message. ${prompt} by default.
- Temperature - 0 to 2, 0.7 by default. Lower is more predictable.
- Max Tokens - ceiling on the reply length, 4000 by default.
- Reasoning Effort - low, medium or high, for reasoning models. Blank leaves it to the model.

In and out In: data whose fields fill the ${...} placeholders, or a JSON artifact to send as it is. Out: the reply, the model that answered, the input and output token counts, and a one-line summary of the call.

Use it when
- A step needs text written, summarised, classified or rewritten with a capable general model.
- You want a managed model without bringing your own key.
- You want the token counts of a step passed on with its reply.

component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: agent
name: AI Foundry GPT-5.2 Agent
description: >
  Sends one prompt to a platform-managed Azure AI Foundry model (gpt-5.2 by
  default) through perceivo.managed_service.ai and returns the reply with its
  token counts. ${field} placeholders in the prompts are filled from
  request_data. The platform books the token cost. A failed call or an
  empty reply raises and fails the run.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    # The artifact is read only as a fallback for the user message, so it is
    # welcome but never required.
    artifact_type_input: optional(json)
    # Placeholders read request_data by whatever name the prompts give, so no
    # key is required. `prompt` is the one the default User Prompt reads.
    request_data:
      prompt: string (optional) - The user message, read by the default User Prompt ${prompt}.
    artifact_type_output: json
    response_data:
      response: string - The model's reply.
      model: string - The model that answered.
      tokens_in: integer - Prompt tokens consumed.
      tokens_out: integer - Reply tokens consumed, including any reasoning tokens.
      conversation_log: string - One-line summary of the call.

input_parameters:
- name: model
  type: select
  label: Model
  options:
  - gpt-5.2
  - gpt-5-nano
  - o4-mini
  - grok-4-1-fast-reasoning
  default: gpt-5.2
  required: true
  description: Managed Azure AI Foundry model to call. The platform holds the credentials.
- name: system_prompt
  type: text_long
  label: System Prompt
  default: You are a helpful assistant.
  required: true
  description: Standing instruction for the model. ${field} placeholders are filled from incoming data.
- name: user_prompt
  type: text_long
  label: User Prompt
  default: ${prompt}
  required: false
  description: The message. ${field} or ${nested.field} is filled from incoming data. When blank, or when a named field is missing, the incoming artifact or data is sent instead.
- name: temperature
  type: number
  label: Temperature
  default: 0.7
  required: false
  constraints:
    min: 0
    max: 2
    step: 0.1
  description: Lower is more predictable, higher more varied.
- name: max_tokens
  type: integer
  label: Max Tokens
  default: 4000
  required: false
  constraints:
    min: 100
    max: 100000
  description: Ceiling on the reply length. Reasoning models spend part of it thinking.
- name: reasoning_effort
  type: select
  label: Reasoning Effort
  options:
  - low
  - medium
  - high
  default: ''
  required: false
  description: For reasoning models only. Leave blank to let the model decide.

prompt.description: The user message, read by the default User Prompt ${prompt}.

tokens_out.description: Reply tokens consumed, including any reasoning tokens.
